newsitem.title: USA: Ultra Pac sees improved Q4 performance.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Pac sees improved Q4 performance.

text.p: Ultra Pac Inc said Tuesday it expects significantly improved performance in the fourth quarter over the loss it recorded in the same year-earlier period.

"While we anticipate sales to decline in the fourth quarter consistent with prior years, our improved cost structure should yield significantly improved performance over last year's fourth quarter loss," said chief executive officer Cal Krupa in a statement.
In the fourth quarter ended January 31, 1996, Ultra Pac posted a loss of $0.54 per share.

Earlier Tuesday, Ulta Pac reported a third-quarter profit compared with a year-ago loss and said results were helped by lower raw material costs, lower production labor costs and improved manufacturing efficiencies.
"Our business performed significantly better than expected," said chief executive officer Cal Krupa.
He said the price of PETE resin, the primary component of the food packaging company's products, continued to fall in the third quarter but is expected to be flat in the remainder of the fiscal year.
